description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to appoint Prof. Jayantha Walihinda to be the Competent Authority of the Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute w.e.f. 27.05.2017
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Lakshman Kiriella) in his official capacity as Minister and appoints another named individual (Professor Jayantha Walihinda) to a specific position (Competent Authority) with detailed responsibilities (exercising powers of the Director of Gampaha Wickramarachchi Ayurveda Institute). It contains both the "who" (government personnel) and the "what" (detailed administrative responsibilities and functions), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
